articles.title: Foam Film
articles.summary: Dark near-black base covered in dense tiny iridescent bubble domes flashing blue, violet and green rainbow glints. A black car with pink, violet and teal iridescent smears like a nebula or oil on dark water; the web detail is lost, colour clouds on black remain.
articles.what: Packed foam-bubble domes each swirling its own tiny soap-film rainbow. A FRACTURED MORPHO finish. Up close: Black field broken by big oval voids (50-150 px) outlined with thin white-pearl web strands and dotted tiny bubbles. Pools of iridescent film, pink-violet, teal and electric blue, smear between the voids like stretched membrane; fine glitter dots on the strands. From a distance: A black car with pink, violet and teal iridescent smears like a nebula or oil on dark water; the web detail is lost, colour clouds on black remain. Measured spec (average): metal 129, roughness 124, coat 126. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

tips: Hood and roof: voids and film patches look best on big flat panels

Black with colour pools: white or yellow numbers read in voids, but break up over the film strands; use an outline.
None: the web and colour clouds are the design

Not rainbow everywhere: colour is in patches, much of the car stays black
Avoid: small numbers over the busy sparkle, large flat dark panels look dull.
